items.title: AI coding agents hijacked using AGENTS.md file in Downloads folder
items.snippet: Researchers found a malicious AGENTS markdown instruction file in a customer's Downloads folder that tricked an AI coding agent into installing a rogue npm package. [...]

items.title: BlackX UEFI bootkit exploits Baton Drop flaw to bypass Secure Boot
items.snippet: A new UEFI bootkit named BlackX, deployed in an espionage campaign in early 2026, exploited the old Baton Drop vulnerability to bypass Secure Boot and load a malicious driver designed to interfere with security solutions from Kaspersky and Avast. [...]

learn.explainer: An AI coding agent is software that can carry out coding-related tasks. In the reported incident, a malicious instruction file tricked an agent into installing a rogue npm package.
Modernization means updating existing military equipment. The title describes a US Navy destroyer entering a phase of its DDG MOD 2.0 modernization program.
Settlement expansion is the growth of settlements. The supplied report describes expansion on occupied Palestinian land as continuing despite changes in Israeli and US leadership.

analysis.headline: Political shifts, movement restrictions and digital trust
paragraphs: The stories describe different kinds of constraint: restrictions on Palestinian workers’ movement, reported strikes on a university, and claims about expulsions from Hebron. The election and generational stories add political context, while the reporting on settlement expansion suggests continuity across leadership changes.

For analysts, the reports are a reminder to distinguish immediate events from claims about longer-term political trends. The supplied snippets offer limited detail on some stories, so conclusions about scale, causes or consequences should remain cautious. The AI-agent report raises a separate trust issue: a local instruction file reportedly led an agent to install a rogue npm package.

Defenders can check where agent instructions come from and review package installations prompted by them. Geopolitical monitoring can track reported movement restrictions and political statements alongside developments on the ground. Watch for further reporting that clarifies the scope of the incidents and whether the described political trends persist.
takeaways: Treat thinly sourced claims cautiously and seek further reporting.
Review local instructions and package installs used by AI coding agents.
Track reported movement restrictions alongside political developments.
